title: Blood of Elves
author: Andrzej Sapkowski
summary: The first full novel in the Witcher saga. The monster hunter Geralt takes charge of a young girl with strange inherited power, while a southern empire gathers its armies and many parties want to find her.
readIf: you like gritty fantasy with dry humour, moral grey areas and a reluctant guardian at the centre.
skipIf: you would rather start with the short stories, which introduce Geralt and are easier to enter.

pairings.reason: The short-story collection that introduces Geralt and the world, which makes this novel richer.
Shares the cynical wit and the sense that no side in the story is clean.
Another quiet, character-first fantasy about a lonely young person caught up in royal schemes.
